protactinium.definition: n. a short-lived radioactive metallic element formed from uranium and disintegrating into actinium and then into lead

protagon.definition:
n. A nitrogenous phosphorized principle found in brain
   tissue. By decomposition it yields neurine, fatty acids, and other
   bodies.
protagon.translation:
[化] 初磷脂; 脑组织素
[医] 初磷脂(得自脑组织)

protagonist.definition: n. the principal character in a work of fiction
protagonist.translation: n. 主人公, 主角, 领导者

protagonists.definition:
n. a person who backs a politician or a team etc.
n. the principal character in a work of fiction
protagonists.translation: n. （戏剧的）主角( protagonist的复数形式 ); （故事的）主人公; 现实事件（尤指冲突和争端的）主要参与者; 领导者

protagoras.translation: 普罗塔哥拉(约前480-约前410, 希腊哲学家)

protamin.definition:
n. An amorphous nitrogenous substance found in the spermatic
   fluid of salmon. It is soluble in water, which an alkaline reaction,
   and unites with acids and metallic bases.

protaminase.translation: 鱼精蛋白酶, 羧肽酶B

protamine.definition: n a simple protein found in fish sperm; rich in arginine; simpler in composition than globulin or albumin; counteracts the anticoagulant effect of heparin

protamine zinc insulin suspension.translation: [化] 鱼精蛋白锌胰岛素悬浮体

protamines.definition: n. a simple protein found in fish sperm; rich in arginine; simpler in composition than globulin or albumin; counteracts the anticoagulant effect of heparin

protan.translation: 红色盲基因, 第一色盲基因

protandric.definition:
a. Having male sexual organs while young, and female
   organs later in life.

protandrous hermaphroditism.translation: [医] 先男后女两性畸形(男性器官先发育,随后女性器官发育)

protanopia.definition: n dichromacy characterized by lowered sensitivity to long wavelengths of light resulting in an inability to distinguish red and purplish blue

protanopic.definition: s inability to see the color red or to distinguish red and bluish-green

protasis.definition:
n. A proposition; a maxim.
n. The introductory or subordinate member of a sentence,
   generally of a conditional sentence; -- opposed to apodosis. See
   Apodosis.
n. The first part of a drama, of a poem, or the like; the
   introduction; opposed to epitasis.
protasis.translation: n. 条件从句, 序诗

protaspid.translation: 三叶虫幼虫期的, 与三叶虫幼虫期有关的
